title: Admin console: add an in-UI path back to the customer workspace
description:
Follow-up to fix commit b992a95 (fix(admin): give admins their own account page in the console).

Context / why:
The admin sidebar footer profile used to link to /account (in the (workspace) route group), which rendered under WorkspaceChrome. That link doubled as the ONLY in-UI bridge from the admin console into the customer workspace (Solutions/Recent/Favorites). The fix repointed it to /admin/account so admins get their own account inside the admin chrome — correct per the product decision, but it removed that bridge.

Current state (verified):
- No link from the admin console -> customer workspace (none anywhere in src/app/(admin)/).
- No link from the customer workspace -> admin console either (pre-existing; workspace-nav.tsx deliberately keeps 'no admin affordances').
Admins are not locked out — they can still reach / by typing the URL — but there is no clickable affordance from the console.

Decision needed: do admins need to use the customer workspace? If yes, add an explicit admin-only affordance (e.g. an 'Open workspace' link in the admin footer or nav) linking to /. If admins live only in the console, close as won't-do.

Acceptance criteria:
- From the admin console an admin can click a visible control to enter the customer workspace hub (/).
- The control is admin-only and matches the prototype/design placement.
- Regular workspace members see no change.
